notes.title: New ladder season begins June 14th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Buffed many skills that were too weak. Most skills should now feel strong to play.
[*] New skills
[*] New unique items
[*] A new class (Pathfinder)
[*] Uber beacons (a new type of beacon with high difficulty and high rewards)
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

This update started with the aim to improve weak skills. For the game to be
enjoyable, players should feel like they are owning. Skills should be designed
to make the player feel that. It is good if skills are powerful if they give the
player dopamine when used. It is okay if skills are powerful. Buffing one skill
doesn't make other skills weaker. It just makes them weaker relative to the buffed skill.
But, if players own the game with one skill, and even complete it, the hypothesis is
that it will make them want to try other skills and beat the game again, which is one
of our main goals. We have too often nerfed skills that were fun just to make the game
balanced. Fun is more important than balance.
If players remember that they were owning, they will remember the game and want
to return to it later.
To make players feel like they own, they must overcome obstacles.
Therefore, the game should not be too easy. Owning the hardest content should
require skill, but mainly better items that require time to craft (because you need
gold and other crafting materials).
If the player finds a character that they like, there should be ways to make that
character stronger, and further challenges as well. In particular, crafting and
rare item properties can be motivating. Getting a new and better item feels like
you just got a new toy.

notes.title: Ladder season 8: Dimensional Hooking
notes.content:
[u][b]Dimensional hooking[/b][/u]
Throughout the world are scattered cracks in space. You can reach into cracks with a dimensional hook. The longer the hook reach is, the deeper you can reach. Interdimensional space contains things that can be of value but there are also dangers there. You may hook interdimensional beings or planar travelers. The deeper you go, the more dangerous it gets.

[u][b]Hook reach[/b][/u]
Every character has a specific hook reach, as shown in the character sheet. Hook reach determines how deep you can reach into the dimensional crack. The further you reach, the more events are possible. Greater depth offers greater rewards but also greater risks. Whenever you send the hook into a crack, a depth is chosen between 1 and the hook’s reach. Each depth has a specific event that will happen.
Each time you use the hook, there is 100% chance to increase its reach by 1. The chance decreases to 75% when the hook’s reach is 10 or higher. There is no maximum hook reach, nor is there a maximum depth to search. Difficulty and rewards continue to scale with depth indefinitely.

[u][b]Bounty[/b][/u]
Dimensional hooking always yields a gold bounty. In addition, there is a chance to drop bait.
Some events are solely rewarding without challenge. Some items cannot be obtained outside dimensional hooking.

[u][b]Bait[/b][/u]
If you have at least one bait in your inventory when you send the hook into the crack, the top-most bait in your inventory is consumed, adding its effect to the event. Not all effects are relevant to all events. Some bait properties are the same as beacon properties but they add abilities only to monsters that would spawn out of the crack, if any.
You can only carry three pieces of dimensional bait. If a fourth would drop, it’s destroyed instead. It’s advisable to keep up the quality by deleting bad ones so you get the most out of cracks when you find them.

[u][b]Boss[/b][/u]
Dimensional hooking adds another end boss. Winning the ladder entails killing all end bosses, including the new one.
The end boss appears on depth 20. Until you’ve killed the end boss, any depth above 20 is downgraded to 20.

[u][b]Dimensional-only unique items[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Full Moon (Amulet): On kill, you have 5% chance to shapeshift into a Werebear for 12 seconds (attack speed set to 4 and magic/dark resistance set to 50).
[*] Whirling Whispers (Mask): Double crit chance. Half crit damage bonus.
[*] The Elephant (Oak Trunk). +100 strength, +200 life, +25 physical resistance.
[*] Umbog (Greataxe): Your highest crit chance is added to all non-physical resistances.
[*] Harvest Celebration (Scimitar): +20 pp to maximum block chance.
[*] Incandescence (Staff): Bolt skills deal splash damage.
[*] Old Akino (Ring): Double Ignite damage. Deal no other fire damage.
[*] Evanescence (Vambraces): +25% Cleave radius for 8 seconds on kill (max 200%)
[*] Euphoria (Ring): Trigger Nova on up to 2 Lightning Bolts instead of on yourself.
[*] 5 unique baits
[/list]

[u][b]Dimensional-only item properties[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Rebound (weapon): Every 3 seconds when you cast a spell, an additional copy of that spell is cast 1 second later.
[*] Fuse (weapon): Attack speed is half. Fuse [random fusable spell] onto fusable spells.
[*] Fork (weapon): Attack speed is half. Cast fusable spells an additional time.
[*] Exuberance: +30% divine damage while at full life.
[*] Suspend (wand, staff, ranged): -80% projectile speed.
[*] Shockwave (weapon): Whenever an enemy dies from lightning damage, they explode, dealing 1 to 2*CLvl lightning damage within 1 meter radius.
[*] Chemistry (gloves): +X% life and mana recovery from catalysts.
[*] Piercing projectiles seek new targets (ranged weapon, spear or mage weapon)
[*] X% chance to negate fire damage (armor)
[*] X% chance to negate cold damage (armor)
[/list]

[u][b]The game now has a more clear beginning and end[/b][/u]
Winning means to kill all end bosses: Drex, Zirth, Venka, Calir, Targon and the new dimensional hooking boss.
Winning now shows a reward animation, a text, and plays a congratulatory sound.
Each character now tracks its own progress, which can be seen in the character sheet.
Each of the boss quests is now considerably shorter.

[u][b]Other new features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] 4 new subplane mods
[*] 3 new Sorcerer skills
[*] Added the ability to host third-party realms
[*] Quality-of-life improvements
[*] Balance changes
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

See the [url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/g8deyhsrg73c2an/Changelog.txt?dl=0]change log[/url] for a list of all changes.

notes.title: Ladder season 3 begins December 27
notes.content:
Ladder season 3 is called "The Evil Mist". The Evil Mist is a method for the invaders to almost effortlessly planeshift hordes of creatures into the material plane. The mist is created by Mist Beings that simply breathe it. The mist is multidimensional, sifting through the weave between planes, jumping from place to place. It is always present in a single area and changes location frequently.

Major features of this update include:
[list]
[*] Four new classes: Doomcaster, Avenger, Knight and Mystic.
[*] Four new crafting options: Enhance, Imbue, Sap and Transform.
[*] Beacons: Objects you can activate to make an area more difficult for one minute, adding rewards.
[*] Catalysts: Items that grant short-duration skills called Surges.
[*] More than 20 new skills.
[*] More than 20 build-around unique items.
[/list]
A major change has also been made to the skill system. In the old system, each skill had a level between 1 and 20. In the new system, you either have a skill or not. Once picked, a skill has maximum effect immediately, though its power scales with character level. You pick one skill on level 1 and then one every four levels (4, 8, etc) for 26 total at level 100.

The season beings December 27 at 16:00 GMT. Join us on Discord for spoilers, questions and discussion: https://discord.gg/6ZzbGM.

notes.title: Edge of Existence (update 0.40) released today
notes.content:
Three months after release, we are announcing a content update.

This update introduces a new town, Lansarot, which is a demiplane attached to Wormhole, making it a perfect outpost for planar travel. The areas south of Lansarot lead further out in the multiverse, all the way to and beyond the Edge of Existence where the Border Spinner and Border Eater fight an eternal battle.

A new class: Sorcerer. It is a master of elements, able to change how elements work.

More variation: We've added spike traps, natural hazards, random events and more varied special mobs.

Three new unique items, each enabling a new type of build.

Various quality of life improvements such as stackable orbs.

Shapechanging revision: No shapeshifts are buffs anymore. All shapeshifts override certain stats. Many shapes change size with skill level. You can become a T Rex if you max out Dinosaur Shape.

And the usual: Bug fixes, balance changes, tooltip fixes etc.

A full change log can be found here:
https://www.dropbox.com/s/g8deyhsrg73c2an/Changelog.txt?dl=0
